# chain-ops

> chain-ops ships pay-per-call on-chain data APIs for AI agents (x402, USDC on Base, no API keys) and @chain-ops/agent-sdk, an x402 V1 + V2 client SDK with ERC-8004 agent identity registration.

chain-ops bridges two protocols that don't talk to each other: x402 gives AI agents a payment rail (HTTP 402 Payment Required), and ERC-8004 gives them an on-chain identity and reputation. The SDK handles the 402 flow (parse requirements, sign the EIP-3009 USDC authorization, retry) in `await agent.pay(url)`, and exposes ERC-8004 `registerAgent()` and `getTrustScore()`. Automatic identity attachment and reputation updates are on the roadmap.

## SDK

- [npm: @chain-ops/agent-sdk](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chain-ops/agent-sdk): One-line x402 + ERC-8004 SDK for Node 18+. MIT licensed.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/dlrjsdl200-byte): Source code and issues.

Quickstart:

```
npm install @chain-ops/agent-sdk viem
```

```ts
import { createAgent } from "@chain-ops/agent-sdk";
const agent = createAgent({ account: process.env.PRIVATE_KEY, network: "base" });
await agent.registerAgent({ name: "my-agent", tags: ["gas", "evm"] }); // one-time
const { body } = await agent.pay("https://api.mgo.chain-ops.xyz/gas/basic");
```

## APIs (pay-per-call via x402, USDC on Base)

- [MGO — Multi-chain Gas Optimizer](https://api.mgo.chain-ops.xyz/llms.txt): Compare real-time gas prices across 9 EVM chains and get the cheapest-chain recommendation. $0.001/call basic (ETH, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism), $0.002/call premium (adds BNB, Polygon, Avalanche, zkSync, Hyperliquid). Free demo endpoint: https://api.mgo.chain-ops.xyz/gas/demo
- [npm: chain-ops-mgo](https://www.npmjs.com/package/chain-ops-mgo): MGO client package with auto-pay via @chain-ops/agent-sdk.
- MCP endpoint: https://api.mgo.chain-ops.xyz/mcp (Streamable HTTP; official MCP Registry name xyz.chain-ops/mgo). Tools: get_gas_demo, get_cheapest_chain (free), get_gas_basic, get_gas_premium (x402).
- Free token prices: https://api.mgo.chain-ops.xyz/prices
- OpenAPI: https://api.mgo.chain-ops.xyz/openapi.json

## Protocols

- [x402](https://x402.org): HTTP-native micropayment protocol (402 Payment Required).
- [ERC-8004](https://github.com/ethereum/ERCs/blob/master/ERCS/erc-8004.md): Trustless Agents — on-chain agent identity and reputation.

## Optional

- [x402Hub](https://x402.chain-ops.xyz): Trust board and discovery for x402 API and MCP services (live).
- [HyperPulse](https://hyperpulse-web.vercel.app): Hyperliquid perp intelligence dashboard (live).
